# Architecture Review Checklist

- [ ] Problem, scope, and constraints are understood.
- [ ] Ownership, contracts, data flow, and dependency directions are explicit.
- [ ] The design preserves the boundaries in `boundaries.md`, or an exception is documented.
- [ ] Relevant quality attributes have measurable targets and trade-offs.
- [ ] Security, privacy, and trust boundaries have been assessed.
- [ ] Failure behavior covers timeouts, retries, idempotency, and degraded operation.
- [ ] Observability includes appropriate logs, metrics, traces, and operational ownership.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, rollout, and rollback paths are viable.
- [ ] Alternatives were considered and the chosen option is proportionate.
- [ ] A system design and, when needed, an ADR are linked to the work.
